attemptPolicy: One exclusive round-wide acceptance attempt; one Chrome startup; each case once. Preserve failures without an accepting rerun.

scope.description: Manual DOM reproducing current installed ToolRow/DisclosureRow/TextShimmer base containment with verbatim current installed CSS and light theme. Synthetic summaries/diffs and explicit local handlers. Source-only exact installed pure functions execute in a VM; no React or application execution.
scope.input: Only CDP events in own exact PID/profile/port-verified headless Chrome. No hardware input, monitor, original Electron or application parity claim. Row keyboard handler is explicit local code. Path Space activation uses a documented explicit LOCAL keydown handler, not React/native-button default certification. No native-button Enter activation assertion.
scope.network: No server; file CSP denies network and CDP blocks HTTP/HTTPS/WS/WSS. Only own loopback CDP endpoint contacted.

compactPolicy: Unique CSS/maps/hashes and pure source/table only once in sidecar; computed styles interned once; final boxes once per scenario; transitions scalar only; combined JSON <250KB.

limitations: Installed artifacts are authority. Older read-only TypeScript only locates and explains verified symbols; installed ui-primitives package is absent, current webdist supplies the primitive implementation.
Manual DOM/local callbacks do not execute React, useDisclosure, application openFile dispatch, host file navigation, actual ReadBlock/DiffBlock bodies or session/model logic.
Path click logs callback arguments only; no file is opened. URL anchor attributes/styles/keydown isolation are measured without navigating or opening a target.
Running/preparing shimmer source and CSS are recorded only. Decoration timing, motion, reduced-motion behavior and React decorative duplication are not certified.
System font resolution and baseline light tokens only. DPR1 is a startup flag, no Emulation or hardware-input assertion.
